title: Toolcall AuditBench: selection-accuracy & arg-schema validator for config/model change regressions
creator: Samira Gupta
description: Build an automated evaluation suite (AuditBench) that continuously measures tool/function selection accuracy and argument validation fidelity against a stable canonical oracle whenever configuration or model artifacts change. The suite will run in CI and as a nightly job, emit regression alerts, and push structured telemetry to the Console so PMs and SREs can triage. Primary goals: detect selection-accuracy regressions caused by model updates or config drift, catch malformed/unsafe tool arguments produced by the model, and provide reproducible artifacts to debug root cause.
acceptance_criteria: AuditBench runs automatically on model/config PRs and nightly for all supported toolcall-enabled models
Selection accuracy metric (Top-1 and Top-3) computed per-model and per-prompt-slice and compared against historical baseline
Argument validation pass rate (schema conformance + simple safety heuristics) reported and trended
Regression alert triggers when selection accuracy drops >4% absolute or arg validation drops >6% over baseline for a production model
CI gate fails for P0 model PRs when selection OR arg-validation regresses beyond thresholds, with an auto-created ticket and attached artifact bundle
Artifacts (sample inputs, model outputs, parsed args, scoring diff) are stored in S3 and linked from the failure ticket
plan: Phase 1: Design — finalize scoring definitions, canonical oracle format, and artifact schema (1 week)
Phase 2: Implementation — selection scorer, arg-schema validator, artifact storage and small runner for local dev (2 weeks)
Phase 3: CI integration — GitHub Actions job for model/config PRs, nightly scheduler job, and webhook to create regression issues (1 week)
Phase 4: Console integration — surface metrics & per-model time series, and attach artifact links to alerts (1 week)
Phase 5: Rollout — enable for a pilot set of models + collect feedback, iterate thresholds and false-positive handling (2 weeks)
Phase 6: Scale — add more models, optimize runner performance and cost (ongoing)
telemetry: Metrics emitted: tool_selection_top1, tool_selection_top3, arg_schema_pass_rate, arg_safety_fails
Tags: model_name, model_version, config_hash, prompt_slice, run_id
Dashboards: InvocationQuality / Toolcall AuditBench (early draft available)
Alerting: PagerDuty for P0 regressions, Slack channel #toolcall-regressions for non-blocking alerts
infra_requirements: S3 bucket with lifecycle policy for artifact bundles
Dedicated ephemeral runners in CI with GPU CPU balance for fast execution (small models)
KMS key for encryption of stored artifacts
Redwood Console metric ingest endpoint and dashboard space allocation
testing_notes: Unit tests for scorer and arg-schema validator using a curated gold dataset
Integration test that runs AuditBench against a known stable model and verifies baseline metrics
Fuzz-run to ensure validator flags malformed arguments (randomized arg shapes and sizes)
PR check that simulates a model config bump and expects no regression for the pilot models
rollout_steps: 1) Merge AuditBench core library behind feature flag
2) Enable CI job for internal pilot models (canary group)
3) Run 3 nightly passes and fine-tune thresholds based on false positives
4) Open a beta for product teams wanting early visibility
5) Gradually expand to all production models and enforce as PR gating for runtime-1.21 release
